rules.name: GROWTH BEGETS GROWTH
rules.text: You have 6 [Presence] tracks. (As usual, you may add [Presence] from any track.) 4 of the [Presence] tracks are next to rows of Growth choices: these choices start unavailable. Upon emptying a Growth track, pick one of its two Growth choices to be immediately available. The other stays unavailable for the rest of the game (cover with a spare piece) . After you add [Presence] from a space marked [Energyplus1] , gain 1 Energy.
rules.turn:
add-from-track S P L, at P Sp, space:track Sp T, track:growth T
  >uncover S P
  track-count T N, le N 1
  ?[rng] G
  !(track:choice T G)
  ~unlock S G
unlock S C, is C G, +growth-available S G
add-from-track S P L, at P Sp, space:bonus Sp energy+1
  +gain-energy S 1
rules.evidence: adding a1 empties track tg: unlock picks one of its two choices (gain-power-and-energy or add-two-presence by seed), Growth can then choose it; the Energy+1 space gives gain-energy starlight 1.
rules.notes: Unavailable = no row; 'the other stays unavailable' needs no rule. 'Upon emptying' reads the track count after the uncover (`>uncover`, le N 1 because the count is read at the window start). Partial: 6 tracks/space order not modeled, and core's add-presence (from `supply`) had to be replaced by an add-from-track BASE-EXT.

rules.name: SLOWLY COALESCING NATURE
rules.text: After revealing an [Element] , place 1 Element Marker of your choice on it. That element is permanent and is constantly available (As if pre-printed on the [Presence] track.)
rules.turn:
add-from-track S P L, at P Sp, space:bonus Sp element
  ?[rng] E
  !(element E)
  ~marker S E
marker S C, is C E, +permanent-element S E
permanent-element S E / elements S E 1
rules.evidence: marker on the revealed Element space chooses air/water/fire by seed; report: starlight-element air 1 (core's elements acc includes it).
rules.notes: 'As if pre-printed' = one more contribution to core's elements @sum; no core change.

base_ext: Energy @sum; Presence-track spaces and tracks as locations with counts; add-from-track; Growth as a choice over growth-available rows.
language_issues: run.sh's output filter hides any tuple whose name starts with `element`/`power`/`land`/`spirit`…; a report tuple named element-report silently vanished (renamed).
Counts read 'after' an action inside the same rule still see the value from the window start (le N 1 instead of N = 0), an easy off-by-one.
